title: Force Fields in Molecular Dynamics: The Engine of Accurate Biomolecular Simulation and Drug Discovery
description: A comprehensive overview of the role, development, and application of force fields in Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations, covering foundational concepts, major force field families (AMBER, CHARMM, OPLS), and advanced methodologies including polarizable and machine learning models for applications in drug discovery and materials science.
audience: Researchers, Computational Chemists, Drug Development Professionals
